topic: Saying No to the Extra Warranty at the Laptop Counter

script.title: AT THE LAPTOP COUNTER
script.scene_zh: 筆電櫃台 · 結帳勸售
script.story_hook: The clerk offers a plan she does not need.
script.intro_zh: 櫃台推薦了一份其實用不到的延保。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to today's laptop counter. Listen for polite ways to say no.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的筆電櫃台。留意委婉說不的說法。
script.outro: And that's a friendly no at checkout. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一次禮貌的拒絕就這樣完成。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a young college woman in her early twenties with long straight jet-black hair in a low ponytail, two silver hair clips, an oversized cream cardigan over a white tee, brown corduroy pants, and a petite slight build
script.char_b_description: a friendly middle-aged man in his forties with closely cropped dark brown hair, thin wire-frame glasses, a burgundy store polo with a name lanyard, a card reader clipped to his black belt, and a tall lean build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, just this one laptop, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ dʒʌst ðɪs wʌn ˈlæpˌtɑpl pliz/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我就要這一台筆電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice pick. Want to add the protection plan?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs pɪk wɑnt tə æd ðə prəˈtɛkʃən plæn/
dialogue.zh: 選得不錯。要不要加一份保護計畫？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The warranty thing? How much is that again?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɔrənti θɪŋ haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðæt əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 延保那個嗎？多少錢來著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty dollars for two extra years of coverage.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti ˈdɑlərz fɚ tu ˈɛkstrə jɪrz əv ˈkʌvɚɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 五十美元，延長兩年的保障。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, I think I'll actually skip it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm aɪ θɪŋk aɪl ˈæktʃuəli skɪp ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我想我這次就先不要了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, can I ask why, if you don't mind?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ kən aɪ æsk waɪ ɪf ju doʊnt maɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，方便問一下原因嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, my card itself covers it, I checked last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl maɪ kɑɹd ɪtˈsɛlf ˈkʌvɚz ɪt aɪ tʃɛkt læst wik/
dialogue.zh: 因為我那張卡本身就有保，上週剛查過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, most cards only do ninety days.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ moʊst kɑɹdz ˈoʊnli du ˈnaɪnti deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 噢，大部分卡只保九十天而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It runs a full twelve months, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɹʌnz ə fʊl twɛlv mʌnθs ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 我這張整整保十二個月呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, that's pretty generous of your bank.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ðæts ˈpɹɪti ˈdʒɛnɹəs əv jɔɹ bæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 哇，你的發卡銀行真大方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, so that feels like paying twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /jeɪ soʊ ðæt filz laɪk ˈpeɪɪŋ twaɪz/
dialogue.zh: 對呀，那就像付兩次錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair. What card is it, if I may?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ wʌt kɑɹd ɪz ɪt ɪf aɪ meɪ/
dialogue.zh: 也對。請問方便說是哪張卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's the campus rewards one from the union.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ðə ˈkæmpəs ɹɪˈwɔɹdz wʌn fɹʌm ðə ˈjunjən/
dialogue.zh: 是學校工會發的那張校園回饋卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh yeah, those do have the long warranty.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ jeɪ ðoʊz du hæv ðə lɔŋ ˈwɔrənti/
dialogue.zh: 噢原來，那種卡真的保比較久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, so I'm covered without paying you more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt soʊ aɪm ˈkʌvɚd wɪˈðaʊt ˈpeɪɪŋ ju mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 對，所以我不用再額外加錢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally your call. Are you a student here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊɾəli jɔɹ kɔl ɑɹ ju ə ˈstudənt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 當然由你決定。你是這裡的學生嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am, does that help the price at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm dʌz ðæt hɛlp ðə pɹaɪs ɑt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 是的，這對價格有幫助嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does, ten percent off with a school ID.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz tɛn pɚˈsɛnt ɔf wɪð ə skul aɪˈdi/
dialogue.zh: 有的，出示學生證打九折。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, here's my student card from school.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs hɪɹz maɪ ˈstudənt kɑɹd fɹʌm skul/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這是我學校的學生卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that one works. Let me scan it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ðʌt wʌns wɝks lɛt mi skæn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 完美，這張可以用，我掃一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Will it still come in the box?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt wɪl ɪt stɪl kʌm ɪn ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 好。它還是會裝在原廠盒裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sealed, with the charger inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs silnd wɪð ðə ˈtʃɑɹdʒɚ ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 會，封條還在，充電器也在盒子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. One small thing... can I ask?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd wʌn smɔl θɪŋ kən aɪ æsk/
dialogue.zh: 好，那還有一點小事，可以問嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, go ahead, what's up?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs ɡoʊ əˈhɛd wʌts ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 當然，你請說，怎麼了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you copy the receipt, not just hand it?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən ju ˈkɑpi ðə ɹɪˈsit nɑt dʒʌst hænd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 收據可以另外影印一份嗎？我要留底。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For your records? Sure, want a photo too?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ jɔɹ ˈɹɛkɚdz ʃʊɹ wɑnt ə ˈfoʊtoʊ tu/
dialogue.zh: 留存用嗎？要不要也拍一張？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, my card warranty needs proof of purchase.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs maɪ ˈkɹɛdɪt ˈwɔrənti nindz pɹuf əv ˈpɝtʃəs/
dialogue.zh: 好，我的卡附的保固需要購買證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Makes sense, I'll email a copy right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪks sɛns aɪl ˈimeɪl ə ˈkɑpi ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 有道理，我現在就寄一份影本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please. And what about my old files?
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz ænd wʌt əˈbaʊt maɪ oʊd faɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩你了。還有我舊電腦裡的檔案呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your old computer? Do you still have it?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ oʊd kəmˈpjutɚ du ju stɪl hæv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你的舊電腦？還留著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's in my bag, I need the photos off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɪn maɪ bæɡ aɪ nid ðə ˈfoʊtoʊz ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 在包裡，我想把裡面的照片抓出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do transfers, it's free if I have time.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du ˈtɹænsfɚz ɪts fɹi ɪf aɪ hæv taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我們能搬檔案，有時間的話免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You have time? Oh, thank you so much.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hæv taɪm oʊ θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 你有空？噢，那真是幫了大忙，謝謝！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, it's my slow hour, no rush at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɪts maɪ sloʊ aʊɹ noʊ ɹʌʃ æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我現在不忙，你不用急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, can everything move over, or just some?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kən ˈɛvɹiˌθɪŋ muv ˈoʊvɚ ɔɹ dʒʌst sʌm/
dialogue.zh: 那全部都能移過去，還是只能選一部分？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Photos, docs, music... anything off the desktop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊz dɑks ˈmjuzɪk ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɔf ðə ˈdɛskˌtɑp/
dialogue.zh: 照片、文件、音樂，桌面上的都能抓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even my browser bookmarks and saved passwords?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən maɪ ˈbɹaʊzɚ ˈbʊkˌmɑɹks ænd sævd ˈpæswɝdz/
dialogue.zh: 連瀏覽器的書籤跟存好的密碼也可以？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bookmarks, yes, but not the passwords, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʊkˌmɑɹks jɛs bʌt nɑt ðə ˈpæswɝdz ˈsædli/
dialogue.zh: 書籤可以，可惜密碼不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's fine, I saved those somewhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts faɪn aɪ seɪvd ðoʊz ˈsomwɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，那些我另外存著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good habit. It'll take maybe twenty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈhæbɪt ɪtl teɪk ˈmeɪbi ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 好習慣。大概要二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty's okay, I can wait and browse.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛntiz oʊkeɪ aɪ kən weɪt ænd bɹaʊz/
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘還好，我可以邊等邊逛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or grab a coffee, there's a cart outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔɹ ɡɹæb ə ˈkɔfi ðɛɹz ə kɑɹt ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 或去買杯咖啡，外面就有攤車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, I'll stay, I want to watch it work.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm aɪl steɪ aɪ wɑnt tə wɑtʃ ɪt wɝk/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我留在這裡，想看你怎麼搬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair enough, most folks don't, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ɪˈnʌf moʊst foʊks doʊnt hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 也好，想守在旁邊看的人並不多，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, how's the total looking with the discount?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ haʊz ðə ˈtoʊɾəl ˈlʊkɪŋ wɪð ðə ˈdɪskaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 那打好折之後，總共多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's nine hundred with the discount on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts naɪn ˈhʌndɹɪd wɪð ðə ˈdɪskaʊnt ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 折扣已扣，總共九百美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine hundred? That beats the online price.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈhʌndɹɪd ðæt bits ðə ˌɑnˈlaɪn pɹaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 九百？這比網路上還便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We try, and we're right here if issues.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi traɪ ænd wɪɹ ɹaɪt hɪɹ ɪf ˈɪʃuz/
dialogue.zh: 我們盡量給好價，而且店就在這，有問題好找。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's actually a big deal to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈæktʃuəli ə bɪɡ dil tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 這對我來說真的很重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We hear it a lot around finals week.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hɪɹ ɪt ə lɑt əˈɹaʊnd ˈfaɪnəlz wik/
dialogue.zh: 每逢期末考週，學生都這樣說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, tell me about it. Can I pay by phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ tɛl mi əˈbaʊt ɪt kən aɪ peɪ baɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 哈，就是說啊。可以用手機付款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, tap away, right on this reader.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ˈtæp əˈweɪ ɹaɪt ɑn ðɪs ˈɹidɚ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，對著感應區輕點一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, it didn't beep... is it working?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ɪt ˈdɪdənt bip ɪz ɪt ˈwɝkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，沒嗶耶……這樣有成功嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more try, hold it a little higher.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔɹ tɹaɪ hoʊld ɪt ə ˈlɪɾəl ˈhaɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 再試一次，稍微拿高一點看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, that beep is my favorite sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ ðæt bip ɪz maɪ ˈfeɪvɚət saʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 有了，那聲嗶是我最愛的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, mine too, it means the day's moving.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ maɪn tu ɪts minz ðə deɪz ˈmuvɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我也是，代表生意在動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Receipt's emailed, transfer's queued. All set.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪˈsits ˈimeɪld ˈtɹænsfɚz kjuːd ɔl sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 收據寄了，檔案也排進了，搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're all set. Name on the pickup tag is?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ɔl sɛt neɪm ɑn ðə ˈpɪkˌʌp tæɡ ɪz/
dialogue.zh: 都辦好了。取件標籤上寫的名字是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nora, and thanks for all the patience.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɔɹə ænd θæŋks fɚ ɔl ðə ˈpeɪʃəns/
dialogue.zh: 諾拉，謝謝你這麼有耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, Nora. Enjoy the new laptop!
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tə mit ju ˈnɔɹə ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə nju ˈlæpˌtɑp/
dialogue.zh: 很高興認識你，諾拉，享受新電腦！

script.youtube_title_en: "My Card Itself Covers It" — Politely Declining the Laptop Warranty
script.youtube_description:
「我的卡本身就附保固」——在筆電櫃台結帳時，店員推薦的延長保固，該怎麼禮貌又堅定地說不？這一集用 60 句連續真實對話，帶你從保護計畫、信用卡保障、學生折扣，一路聽到影印收據與舊檔案轉移。

你會聽到：婉拒加購的委婉句型；信用卡本身的保固怎麼跟店員解釋；出示學生證打九折；留收據影本當購買證明；還有舊電腦的照片、書籤怎麼搬過去、密碼為何不能搬。全程都是 A2 初級單字與美國人真實會用的短句：um、well、so、ha、yeah。聽完你就敢自己開口：Want to add...、Can you copy...、How's the total looking。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，先聽兩遍，再大聲跟讀一遍，讓耳朵和嘴巴一起記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"My card itself covers it" — the clerk pushes an extended warranty at the laptop counter, and you want to say no without being rude. This 60-line immersive listening practice walks through the whole checkout.

You will hear: polite ways to decline the protection plan, explaining that your credit card already covers it, the student discount with a school ID, keeping a copied receipt as proof of purchase, and moving your photos and bookmarks off an old machine. Everything stays in A2 words with the real small talk Americans use: um, well, so, ha, yeah. By the end you'll own lines like Want to add..., Can you copy..., and How's the total looking.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
難得買一台新筆電，結帳時店員一直推薦延長保固，你該怎麼說不才不會尷尬？學生證到底能不能折價？舊電腦裡的照片又要怎麼辦？

這一集帶你走進賣場筆電櫃台，從保護計畫、信用卡保障、學生折扣，一路聽到影印收據、轉移舊檔案與結帳道別，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
💻 婉拒加購：Um, I think I'll actually skip it.
🎓 學生折扣：It does, ten percent off with a school ID.
🧾 收據留底：Can you copy the receipt, not just hand it?
📁 轉移檔案：So, can everything move over, or just some?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so、yeah 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，只要跟著這趟結帳對話走一趟，下次店員再推銷，你就能禮貌地自己回應。

祝你下次買電腦，省錢又開心。
